unresolvedReferences.description: Liu Min's death year is computed (born c. 1201 from age twelve in 1212; died at 59, c. 1259), not stated.
The text has 乙未 (1235); the English draft renders it as yimao.
Wang Ji's second examination failure is dated only to the Taihe era (1201-1208).
Wang Ji's capture at Zhuolu Pass is inferred as c. 1213.
The commander who raised Liu Min is unnamed.
Chalibi's apportionment and Ahai's list are undated (c. 1220 inferred).
Wang Ji's death in the south is undated (after 1233).
Text has 至大元年 (1308); the English draft renders it Zhide.
Gao Xuan's death year is not given.
Tiansi's advice to Boluo and Zhang Wenqian is inferred as c. 1270.
The 'imperial younger brother, the State Prince' is not identified in the text.
Gao Liang's appointment is dated only by Zhenjin's enfeoffment as Prince of Yan (c. 1263); his death year is not given.
Text has 至大三年 (1310); the English draft renders it Zhide.
Taishibuhua's death year is not given.
The pacification of Wu Xian's followers is dated only to Taizong's reign (c. 1230 inferred).
Jiao Yong's death year is not given.
Ancestor Zan and Song chancellor Fu Bi are named but not offered as candidates; not extracted.
Text has 至大二年 (1309); the English draft renders it Zhide.
Tianlin's return is computed as c. 1284 (1256 plus 28 years).
Tianlin's entry into the guard is computed as c. 1231 (age 14, back-calculated from his death at 92 in 1309).
Ahmad, Jian, Jie, Huaidu, Halanchi, Rong, Subutai, Chaghan and Xialadahai were not offered as candidates and were not extracted.
Yang Huan's failed jinshi attempt is dated only to the end of Jin.
Taizong's reward to Juzhen is undated (c. 1240 inferred).
The building of Shangdu is inferred as c. 1256.
Lou Anbang and Chen Sicong episode inferred c. 1275; Fu Gao c. 1276; Li Zifa and Du Wanyi c. 1278.
Aluhaiya (阿里海涯), Yao Shu, Ahmad, Chen Yizhong and Commissioner Zheng were not offered as full candidates and were not extracted.
Death at 63 in 1280 implies birth c. 1218, versus c. 1219 from age 15 at the fall of Bianjing (1233).
Son Ruli was not offered as a candidate and was not extracted.
